requirements: R1: A booking session starts in the NoReservation state.
R2: When the guest searches for rooms with available inventory while in NoReservation, the system moves to the Browsing state.
R3: When the guest selects an available room and valid dates while in Browsing, the system creates a provisional reservation and moves to PendingPayment.
R4: When payment is successfully authorized while in PendingPayment, the system moves the reservation to Confirmed.
R5: When payment fails while in PendingPayment, the system cancels the provisional reservation and returns to Browsing.
R6: When the guest cancels while in PendingPayment, the system releases the provisional reservation and returns to Browsing.
R7: When the guest cancels a Confirmed reservation before the check-in deadline, the system moves the reservation to Cancelled.
R8: When the guest completes check-in on the arrival date while the reservation is Confirmed, the system moves to CheckedIn.
R9: When the guest completes check-out while CheckedIn, the system moves the reservation to Completed.
R10: When the guest does not arrive before the no-show deadline while Confirmed, the system moves the reservation to Cancelled and records a no-show fee.
R11: The system must not allow check-in unless the reservation is in the Confirmed state.
R12: The system must not move a reservation to Confirmed unless payment authorization succeeded in PendingPayment.
R13: When a modification request for dates is submitted while Confirmed and alternative inventory is available, the system moves to PendingModification until the guest confirms or rejects the change.
